newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-LIONS BEAT FREE STATE 52-30.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIONS BEAT FREE STATE 52-30.

text.p: The British Lions beat Free State 52-30 (halftime 31-13) in their rugby union match on Tuesday.
Free State - Tries: Stephen Brink (2), Jannie de Beer. Conversions: De Beer (3). Penalties: De Beer (3).
British Lions - Tries: Tim Stimpson, John Bentley (3), Alan Bateman, Neil Jenkins, Tony Underwood. Conversions: Stimpson (4). Penalties: Stimpson (3).
